Resolves #21349

A chip field's chips are styled again and sit inside the field's outline. `list.Chip#createItemContent()` now hands its window to every chip it creates, as `list.Circle`, `list.Buffered` and the calendar list already do, so `Neo.component.Chip`'s theme files load even for chips that arrive after the list joined its window (the chip field's store loads by url). Once styled, the 30px chips outgrew the 27px outline an inline label draws. An inline-label chip field now lays out as `Text.css`'s character-count grid does, so the outline spans the input row and an error sits below it.

Prescription checked: `src/list/Chip.mjs` — owns the concern. Each `list.Component` subclass creates its own items in `createItemContent()` and passes `windowId` there.

Evidence: L3 (a unit spec red on base and green at head; a headless browser run on the dev server before and after) → L3 required (AC-1, AC-2, AC-3, AC-5). Residual: none.
